method.caches: warm (Druid broker and historical caches on, as druid_setup ships them)
method.druid_ms: median over rounds of the summed broker query/time per request
method.pairing: reference and candidate apps on one host against one Druid; each round sends the case to both, reference first in even rounds and candidate first in odd ones; a case regresses when its p95 ratio or its paired median ratio (median over rounds of candidate over reference time) is above 1.10 with a paired-bootstrap lower bound above 1; every request on a new connection

dashboards.view: ?screenshot=1 at 1440x900, fresh browser context per load, requests leaving the stack aborted
dashboards.end: first frame with every query tile rendered
dashboards.bytes: median of headers plus encoded bodies received before the last tile

dataset: scripts/perf/dataset.py seed 20261004: 200,000 yellow-fever cases, 2023-01-01..2025-12-31, 579 municipalities; 387,918 Druid rows in harmony_demo_20261004
